name: noticely
description: Per-project list of problems Claude noticed outside the current task, grouped by priority, in a pane opened from a ⚑ count above the prompt; start a background session or file a GitHub or GitLab issue per entry and follow its status

github.title: GitHub
github.description: auto: GitHub buttons and statuses only where origin is a github.com repository; on: always (GitHub Enterprise); off: never

gitlab.title: GitLab
gitlab.description: auto: GitLab buttons and states only where origin is on gitlab.com or a host named gitlab.<domain>; on: always (self-managed GitLab); off: never
